name: COFCO Joycome Foods Limited
summary: COFCO Joycome Foods Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the production and sales of hog, and livestock slaughtering businesses in Mainland China. The company operates through Hog Production, Feed, Fresh Pork, Processed Meat Products, and Meat Import segments. It is also involved in the production and sale of feed; slaughtering, wholesale, and retail sale of fresh and frozen meats; manufacture, wholesale, and retail sale of processed meat products and fresh pork under the Maverick and Joycome brands; and sale of imported meat products, including pork, beef, poultry, and mutton.
